cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Just nod and I'll accept the sofa delivery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will it fit through the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. We can measure after securing the bargain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then nod before they start measuring too.

confusable: S04 mistake must remain a real misinterpretation; D28 cannot quietly become approval after full acceptance.
comparison: Incoming object/access pressure differs from event booking words.
seedUse: D28-b imminent delivery makes sizing questions inconvenient to A.
